intent_snapshot.goal: Replace mirrored Initiative and custom GitHub Task lifecycle tracking with one explicit Local-Markdown-or-GitHub-Parent carrier, native Sub-issues, and terminal-only non-authoritative Child projection while deleting the obsolete mark-active path and contract text.

acceptance.assertion: Planner and tracker enforce one explicit Initiative carrier: Local mode uses minimal Markdown with zero GitHub operations; GitHub mode refuses a matching Local artifact, creates but never rewrites one marker-bound Parent, requires an exact stable Slice marker, creates one neutral open marker-bound Child without a TaskIntent path, and idempotently confirms native Sub-issue attachment while duplicate, wrong-parent, missing-Slice, manual-preclose, capacity, and partial-remote-effect cases fail or recover without changing Kernel state.

The mark-active source, command vocabulary, Enrollment call, custom proposed/active contract text, and obsolete tests are deleted; only an exact claimless terminal projection plus matching tombstone may close a Child as completed or not planned, remote failure remains observation, exact terminal reopen is reclosed, source and packed Planner/Loop contracts match, and Parent closure remains user-owned.

evidence.summary: bun test tests/plugin-package-runtime.test.ts → 18 pass / 0 fail (within file suite; 35 pass across both focused files): create-once Parent with redaction, identical replay returns already_current, changed goal refused without mutation, local docs/initiatives/<slug>.md carrier conflict fails pre-network, missing/duplicate Slice marker ambiguous without child creation, neutral open Child without tracker-state or intent path, native Sub-issue attach/recover/foreign-parent rejection, exact-terminal close/reclose, manual pre-close ambiguity preserved, duplicate identity fail-closed, gh spawn failure closed result, redaction + wrapper routing.

bun test tests/pi-canary-assurance-progression.test.ts → 17 pass / 0 fail: markGithubTaskActive and mark-active fully deleted from imm-canary-enroll.ts and runtime-stub.ts (durable absence guards), deriveGithubTerminalProjectionInput still requires error-free claimless projection with matching terminal tombstone, Work hook orders fresh projection → tombstone read → terminal projection, native Review role contract injection intact. Repo-wide rg confirms no remaining upsert-initiative/mark-active/tracker-state/managed-region references outside the superseding Spec, absence assertions, and archived historical Spec.

approvals.summary: Provenance verified (HEAD and all dirty/neighborhood base_oids and content hashes match the immutable bundle); create-once Parent with carrier-conflict refusal, exact Slice-marker gating, neutral marker-bound Child with idempotent native Sub-issue attach/recover, full deletion of mark-active vocabulary and Enrollment projection, terminal-only tombstone-gated closure across all race/partial-effect paths fail closed, matching packed/source contracts, and embedded QA outcomes passed for A1/A2.
